description: We are a multidisciplinary team of five from the University of Málaga: robotics, mechanics, programming, economics and design. We are building Stars Beside You, a tool that uses NASA data to find places on Earth that resemble lunar sites. We are friendly, curious and love learning from each other. We would love to meet people with skills in GIS, remote sensing, data science, planetary science or web and UX design. Whatever your level, join us!
